items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: when I arrived back in New York I ran into my wife, Ida.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

you first got here, you know. So in order to live like a Frenchman over there you have to accept what they give you, you can't dictate a price to them. So when that day came about when it was time for me to move on for that reason and another reason about the big Christmas time that I wanted to be home for Christmas -- I came home, but then -- easy come, easy go. I made a lot of money but I squandered it away on one thing or another and when I arrived back in New York I ran into my wife, Ida. When we got married…
She's also American Indian. What tribe is she?
